Weekly Product Changelog - September 29, 2026


Added


- Sunny now shows a receipt for every change it makes, with one-click undo and a link to what it changed
- Sunny tells you plainly when a request resulted in no changes


Improved


- Undoing an Autoplan (beta) run now also restores task priorities
- Sunny's replies now describe what actually changed instead of just "Got it"
- Sunny asks for clarification when a request is ambiguous instead of guessing


Fixed


- Notes and daily wrap edits are no longer lost when offline or when a save fails
- Todoist and Gmail panels no longer slow down or freeze the app with long lists
- Repeating iCloud events without a timezone no longer disappear from the calendar
- New calendar events with a pre-filled title no longer ask you to add a title
- Reopened Sunny conversations no longer show replies twice
- Sunny no longer shows error text after an app update
